# Packages whose version can change the numbers in the committed chains under
# data/, rather than only whether the code runs.
#
# The sessions load those chains instead of regenerating them, because a full
# PMMH run takes hours. So the site render proves a bump did not break any code
# path, and proves nothing about whether the sampler still produces the
# committed draws. Two workflows read this list:
#
#   chains-current.yml          reports a pull request that moves one of these
#                              packages' resolved version in Manifest.toml
#                              without regenerating the chains
#   compathelper_automerge.yml  keeps these off auto-merge, so a person decides
#
# Regenerating is a cluster job, not a CI job: scripts/generate_pmcmc_seitl.jl
# and generate_pmcmc_seit4l.jl each take many hours at 256 particles, against a
# six hour limit per CI job.
#
# One bare name per line, nothing else on the line: both readers match the whole
# line, one with grep -qxF and one with read. Every name has to be pinned in
# Manifest.toml, which holds the transitive packages too, and earns its place by
# sitting on the path the generation scripts take:
#
#   Turing                 the sampler's driver
#   AdvancedMH             RobustAdaptiveMetropolis, the proposal itself
#   SSMProblems            the state space model interface
#   GeneralisedFilters     BF, the bootstrap filter
#   LogExpFunctions        logsumexp, which forms the log-likelihood
#   StatsBase              wsample, the resampler
#   DifferentialEquations  the deterministic simulator
#   JumpProcesses          the stochastic simulator
#   Distributions          the priors and the observation model
#
# AdvancedVI is deliberately absent: nothing committed under data/ comes from it.

Turing
AdvancedMH
SSMProblems
GeneralisedFilters
LogExpFunctions
StatsBase
DifferentialEquations
JumpProcesses
Distributions
